# netbox_subscription (Data Source)

Retrieves a single subscription from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_subscription" "example" {
  id = 1
}

output "subscription_id" {
  value = data.netbox_subscription.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the subscription.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the subscription was created.
- `object` (String) The object of the subscription.
- `object_id` (Number) The object id of the subscription.
- `object_type` (String) The object type of the subscription.
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user associated with the subscription.
